description: Send a file from one host to another over the direct UDP channel (relay fallback), verified with SHA-256. Set agent_id to the SOURCE host where the file lives; the destination must be in edit/bypass mode. Returns a transfer id (poll with transfer_get on the same source host).

agent_id.description: Source host agent id (where the file lives)

dest_id.description: Agent id of the destination host

dest_path.description: Absolute path to write on the destination

src_path.description: Path of the file on the source host

name: send_file
